desc: Ideate and derive the formula: Total Ops = Swaps + Distinct Count.
Identify that Swaps = Sum over distinct values $v$ (sorted by first appearance) of (count of elements $u$ in $A[0 \dots \text{last}(v)]$ such that $\text{first}(u) > \text{first}(v)$).
Plan the use of a Fenwick Tree to count these elements efficiently.
Write the Python code to read input, process each test case, and output the result.
